title: IR shared value types
description: Shared definitions for the Lepus intermediate representation. Normative half of SC-110 section 6. These schemas describe the CANONICAL JSON DUMP of the IR (SC-000 section 6), which is what golden tests compare — not an on-disk format the mod reads.

bedrockId.description: Namespaced Bedrock identifier. Namespace defaults to 'minecraft' when the source omitted it; the IR always stores it explicitly. Original case preserved; comparison is case-insensitive.

logicalId.description: The derived Java identifier. SC-120 section 3.

bedrockVersion.description: Engine or format version, creator-facing form.

provenance.description: Where an IR node came from. Mandatory on everything reachable from a pack — SC-110 section 4. A diagnostic without it is useless to an author with forty packs installed.

declaredVersion.description: format_version as written. May disagree with effectiveVersion when structural sniffing overrode it (SC-110 section 3.1).

lossy.description: True when an upgrade or clamp discarded information.

unknown.description: Keys the parser did not recognise, verbatim. SC-110 section 5. Present on every IR record that models a JSON object; empty is normal.

molangExpr.description: A parsed Molang expression. NEVER a raw string in the IR (SC-110 section 7). The dump form records the source for diffability plus whether it folded to a constant.

constant.description: The folded value when the expression is constant, else null. Folding uses float arithmetic (SC-000 section 7).

queries.description: Query identifiers this expression references, for static pre-binding (SC-130 section 5).

parseError.description: Present when parsing failed. The expression then evaluates to 0, matching Bedrock, and SCE-1040 was emitted.

molangFloat.description: A field that Bedrock allows to be either a constant or an expression.

vec3f.description: Bedrock axis conventions, preserved unconverted. Conversion happens in the renderer (SC-110 section 6.1).

rangeF.description: Bedrock's [min, max] or scalar shorthand. A scalar normalises to [v, v].

ticks.description: Integral ticks. Seconds are converted at parse time by round(s * 20) unless the domain says otherwise (SC-000 section 8).

texturePath.description: Pack-relative texture reference WITHOUT extension, as Bedrock writes it.
